authorization: Nathan explicitly requested executing both the Transformer/SSL experiment and real-data acquisition on 2026-09-19.

ibm.test_scope: New future period of the same held-out customer cohort whose v1 2018 results were already inspected; no held-out customers in fitting.
ibm.amount_policy: Successful positive card charges pooled by User across Cards; no known-bill exclusion; absent dates assumed observed zeros after first qualifying transaction.

moneydata.role: excluded from this training, SSL, normalization fitting, selection and benchmark; separately frozen external evaluation only

berka.role: Real-data fallback; acquisition, accounting audit and separate concrete split-policy freeze required before any model fitting
berka.historical_claim: IBM 2016-17 to Berka 1990s is retrospective cross-domain transfer, not a historical deployment simulation

architectures.tcn: 4 residual blocks, width24, two causal kernel3 convolutions each, dilations1/2/4/8; last state plus43 aux ->32 ReLU->14softplus
architectures.gru: one layer hidden48 input3, laststate plus43 aux ->32 ReLU->14softplus
architectures.transformer: input3->32, learned mask embedding, fixed positional encoding, two encoder layers, heads2, FF64, no dropout; meanpool plus43aux ->16 ReLU->14softplus

optional_dlinear: Not admitted: focus the implementation allowance on all four required architectures plus the requested paired SSL study; decided before model scores.
features: History-only scale=max(last28daymean,1 source native unit); 99-feature MLP/ridge; sequence56x3 scaledlag and historicalweekday sin/cos, same43 auxiliary features standardized on current domain training windows only.

training.loss: mean squared error of normalized 14 daily targets
training.selection: validation 14-day total MAE; architecture eligible only if all three seeds finish at least three epochs

ssl.mask_policy: One uniformly chosen contiguous seven-day training-history patch; normalize using visible last28 values only, floor1; zero hidden amounts plus explicit mask embedding; no forecast auxiliary summaries in encoder.
ssl.selection: Use final completed fixed-budget pretraining state, no validation/test reconstruction selection.
ssl.fine_tuning: Reset forecast head with the same seed; transfer only encoder state; target-domain training-only auxiliary normalization.
ssl.compute_matching: Same batch size and optimizer-update target as corresponding SSL plus fine-tuning; record examples and wall-time separately, because update matching is not identical FLOPs or time. IBM uses own SSL+adaptation; Berka uses IBM SSL+adaptation as primary transfer comparison.

final_holdout: Freeze every validation selection before reading final-test outcomes. Report frozen candidates for transparency but never reselect on test. Preserve all three seeds, exact policies, hashes and logs. No MoneyData fallback training or real-world promotion.
